title: Recovery and Reliability
description: Implement recovery logic, retries, and DEGRADED states across drive and inspect planes.
design: session.recover handles reconnects; retry rules are enforced with no infinite loops; diagnostics include failure context.
acceptance_criteria: Drive/inspect failures trigger correct transitions and successful recoveries where possible.

title: Implement session.recover and DEGRADED transitions
description: Add recovery flows for extension/CDP disconnects and transitions to DEGRADED states.
design: Attempt reconnect; on success return to READY; on failure mark BROKEN.
acceptance_criteria: Recovery flow follows state machine rules and is covered by unit tests.

title: Enforce retry rules on drive/inspect ops
description: Apply retry-once logic for retryable drive failures and CDP reconnects on inspect failures.
design: Retry only once per op; never infinite retries; return structured error envelope with retryable flag.
acceptance_criteria: Automated tests cover retry paths and stop conditions.

title: Reliability diagnostics and logging
description: Surface reliability signals in diagnostics and logs to help debug disconnects and mismatches.
design: Include last error codes, last recovery attempt, and connection status for drive/inspect planes.
acceptance_criteria: diagnostics.doctor returns reliability context and logs show recovery outcomes.

title: CLI
description: Implement CLI mirroring MCP capabilities with JSON output and daemon bootstrap.
design: Use commander or yargs; commands map to Core API; start Core if not running; include diagnostics and open-artifacts helpers.
acceptance_criteria: CLI supports session/drive/inspect/diagnostics commands and JSON output via --json.

title: CLI skeleton and Core client
description: Set up CLI entrypoint and a Core HTTP client wrapper.
design: Expose configurable Core host/port; handle JSON output formatting uniformly.
acceptance_criteria: CLI runs and can call Core health/session endpoints.

title: CLI commands for session/drive/inspect
description: Implement CLI commands that mirror MCP tool surface for session, drive, inspect, artifacts, diagnostics.
design: Commands validate inputs with shared schemas and print JSON when requested.
acceptance_criteria: CLI can invoke all major Core endpoints and render JSON output.

title: Daemon bootstrap and helpers
description: Add CLI logic to start Core daemon if not running, plus diagnostics and open-artifacts helpers.
design: Detect running daemon via health endpoint; spawn Core as needed; provide a helper to open artifact folders.
acceptance_criteria: CLI can bootstrap Core and run diagnostics end-to-end.

title: CDP Inspect Plane
description: Implement CDP (Puppeteer) integration and inspect.* APIs in Core.
design: Launch or attach Chrome, maintain CDP connection, implement dom snapshot, console, network HAR, performance metrics, evaluate.
acceptance_criteria: inspect.* endpoints return expected data from a live Chrome session.

title: Puppeteer launch/attach + CDP manager
description: Implement Chrome launch/attach strategy and maintain a CDP session in Core.
design: Support mode auto/attach/launch; default to managed profile with remote debugging; bind to 127.0.0.1.
acceptance_criteria: Core can launch or attach Chrome and reports INSPECT_READY when CDP is live.

title: Implement inspect.* endpoints
description: Add inspect.dom_snapshot, console_list, network_har, performance_metrics, and evaluate.
design: Prefer AX snapshots with HTML fallback; support consistency modes best_effort and quiesce. Inspect operations are read-only by default; evaluate should be used for diagnostics only.
acceptance_criteria: inspect.* endpoints return valid data and respect requested formats.

title: Tab-to-target matching heuristics
description: Match extension tab metadata to CDP targets and verify via document location/title.
design: Match by exact URL, title, recency. Verify via evaluate; retry once then warn.
acceptance_criteria: Target matching selects correct tab in typical multi-tab scenarios and logs warnings on mismatch.

title: Workspace and Shared Schemas
description: Scaffold the monorepo workspace, baseline tooling, and shared schemas/types per requirements.
design: Use npm workspaces (or pnpm if chosen later), TypeScript base config, and a shared package exporting Zod schemas, error envelope, and common types.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace installs cleanly; shared package exports required schemas and types; root scripts for build/lint/test run.

title: Scaffold workspace and tooling
description: Initialize workspace layout and base tooling (TypeScript, lint, test).
design: Create packages/core, packages/shared, packages/mcp-adapter, packages/cli, packages/extension. Add root scripts and TS configs. Decide and document package manager (default npm unless explicitly switched to pnpm).
acceptance_criteria: Workspace initializes successfully; npm install, npm run lint, and npm test succeed with a placeholder test; workspace package folders exist.
notes: Decisions: using npm workspaces (root private package.json) with packages/*; ESLint 9 flat config via eslint.config.mjs + @typescript-eslint parser/plugin; Vitest 4 for placeholder test; TypeScript project references with tsconfig.base.json and per-package tsconfig.json; package names @browser-vision/<pkg> and marked private.

title: Define shared schemas and error envelope
description: Implement shared Zod schemas and common types for MCP tools and Core API.
design: Add Locator, OpResult, SessionInfo/Status, RecoverResult, DiagnosticReport, and error envelope with stable codes and retryable flag in packages/shared.
acceptance_criteria: Schemas validate required tool inputs/outputs and are exported from packages/shared.
notes:
- Added shared schemas in packages/shared/src for Locator/OpResult/SessionInfo/SessionStatus/RecoverResult/DiagnosticReport plus error envelope helpers.
- Error envelope: { ok: false, error: { code, message, retryable, details? } }; success envelope: { ok: true, result }.
- Stable error codes enum includes generic + domain-specific (SESSION_*, DRIVE/INSPECT, EXTENSION/CDP, LOCATOR, NAVIGATION, EVALUATION, ARTIFACT).
- Locator enforces at least one selector; SessionStatus includes optional plane status { connected, last_seen_at, error }.
- Workspace scaffolding (package.json/tsconfig/test runner) missing; no tests added.
- Correction: workspace scaffolding exists (package.json/vitest). Added minimal vitest coverage in packages/shared/src/schemas.test.ts for Locator, OpResult, error envelope, and SessionStatus.
- Added zod dependency to @browser-vision/shared and minimal vitest coverage; npm test -- packages/shared/src/schemas.test.ts passes.

title: Baseline docs and setup instructions
description: Add initial README and developer setup instructions for workspace, core, extension, MCP adapter, and CLI.
design: Document install, build, lint, test commands, and extension loading steps.
acceptance_criteria: README covers setup and basic usage; docs directory references requirements/spec.
notes: Docs coverage: added README with setup/build/lint/test commands, extension loading steps, and links to docs/requirements.md and docs/spec.md. Noted scripts align with workspace scaffolding.

title: Verification and Packaging
description: Add end-to-end verification workflow and packaging hygiene.
design: Document manual test flow and demo script; ensure build artifacts and package metadata are consistent.
acceptance_criteria: Manual demo can be run from clean checkout and outputs expected results.

title: Manual test workflow and demo script
description: Document an end-to-end manual test flow and provide a demo script for local verification.
design: Include steps for starting Core, loading extension, running CLI/MCP calls, and verifying artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Manual checklist produces a consistent verification run on a sample page.

title: Packaging and build hygiene
description: Ensure packages build cleanly and can be packaged from a fresh checkout.
design: Set package metadata, build outputs to dist, and validate with npm pack dry run.
acceptance_criteria: Build succeeds from clean repo and package artifacts are generated correctly.

title: Core Daemon Skeleton and API
description: Implement the Core daemon, session state machine, and HTTP API stubs (no Chrome integration yet).
design: Core is the single source of truth, binds to 127.0.0.1, provides session lifecycle, drive/inspect routing, artifact storage, and diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: Core server runs locally with session endpoints, structured error envelope, and state machine tests.

title: Core server + session state machine
description: Build the Core HTTP server and implement the session lifecycle with required states and transitions.
design: Fastify or Express server, bind to 127.0.0.1 only. In-memory session registry, SessionState enum and transition guards. Expose session.create/status/recover/close (and optional /health).
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover all transitions and retry rules; session endpoints return structured envelopes.

title: Drive/inspect API stubs and routing
description: Add HTTP routes for drive.* and inspect.* with placeholders and proper error envelopes.
design: Implement drive_mutex and route handlers that validate schemas and return NotImplemented until planes are wired.
acceptance_criteria: Routes exist for all tools; responses use standard error envelope and pass schema validation.

title: Artifact storage and diagnostics
description: Implement artifact directory management and diagnostics.doctor in Core.
design: Persist artifacts under /var/folders/3m/9xh9b1px16g6s49cv73pfpzr0000gn/T//browser-agent/<session_id>/, return artifact_id/path/mime. diagnostics.doctor reports Chrome path, extension status, CDP status, and current session state.
acceptance_criteria: Artifacts are written to disk and diagnostics endpoint reports expected fields.

title: Extension Drive Plane
description: Implement the Chrome extension and integrate drive operations with Core.
design: MV3 extension connects to Core over localhost WebSocket; content script executes click/type/scroll/navigate; background manages tabs and reports metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Extension connects to Core, drive operations execute reliably, and Core state transitions to DRIVE_READY.

title: Extension skeleton and WS protocol
description: Build MV3 extension with background service worker and WebSocket client to Core.
design: Define request/response protocol with request_id, action, params, status; connect only to 127.0.0.1.
acceptance_criteria: Extension loads and maintains WS connection to Core; handshake includes tab metadata.

title: Content script actions and tab reporting
description: Implement click/type/scroll/navigate actions and tab list/activate/close reporting.
design: Use chrome.scripting to execute content script actions; background listens to tab events and reports {tabId,url,title,windowId,lastActiveAt}.
acceptance_criteria: Drive actions execute on active tab; tab metadata is reported and kept current.

title: Core drive-plane integration
description: Wire Core drive.* routes to extension actions with drive_mutex and locator resolution.
design: Core forwards drive commands over WS, enforces single in-flight op, applies locator fallback order, and handles retry rules.
acceptance_criteria: drive.navigate/click/type/wait_for/tab_* work end-to-end against a real page.

title: MCP Adapter
description: Expose MCP tools by mapping to Core HTTP API.
design: Use MCP SDK; tool schemas from packages/shared; no business logic in adapter.
acceptance_criteria: All MCP tools are available and forward requests to Core with proper error propagation.

title: MCP server skeleton and tool registration
description: Implement MCP server startup and register all tool schemas from shared package.
design: Expose session.*, drive.*, inspect.*, artifacts.*, diagnostics.*; keep adapter stateless.
acceptance_criteria: MCP server lists all tools and validates inputs.

title: Core API mapping and error propagation
description: Wire MCP tool handlers to Core HTTP API endpoints.
design: Implement a thin Core client, propagate standard error envelope unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: MCP tool calls reach Core and return expected responses or errors.
